## Accepted proper partial-twist parity result, attempt 1/5

AIM problem 2.1, Categorified Hecke algebras, link homology, and Hilbert schemes; corpus 20000079 / AIM-ALGEBRAIC_GEOMETRY-0079, rank 1265. Over C in the stated raw Hogancamp–Mellit convention, gamma=σ2 σ1 σ2² σ1² σ2² has even HHH, while gamma σ1^(2k) has both Rouquier parities for every integer k≥1. Nevertheless, every ordinary unreduced Euler series in the family is coefficientwise nonnegative in q at zero.

The complete proof retains the invariant-coordinate Koszul/Künneth splitting, both six-basis coefficient columns and full trace substitutions, the all-k Hecke recurrence, exact signed reduced coefficients and unreduced sign-coherence decompositions. These tables and formulas are authored symbolic mathematics. The audit retains its independent authored matrix/character argument. A single-step preservation counterexample also holds for reflected and conventional positive Jucys–Murphy braids.

The infinite family concerns the proper FT2=σ1² inside B3, not the central FT3. No all-power Jucys–Murphy theorem, general parity characterization, algebraic-link counterexample or refutation of the pure nested-initial-full-twist question is claimed. The positive-torus parity theorem and the first known nonparity knot 10_139 receive explicit credit. Novelty remains unconfirmed.

## Publication boundary and review limits

Exactly six authored proof/audit/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20000079/`. All authored mathematical statements, proofs, symbolic tables, examples and scope qualifications are retained. Editorial changes remove private workflow/version provenance and supplemental checker/receipt commentary and bind the audit to the exact distributed report.

Programs, checker outputs and receipts, fixtures, datasets, copied third-party source bodies, source-derived images and private coordination/version identities are excluded. No excluded computation is recast as prose. The edition is AI-assisted and unrefereed; scoped acceptance is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Public-source retrieval and inspection are recorded historical observations. Edition preparation claims no fresh scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source inspection or literature search.

QUEUE.md and unrelated entries are unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.
